ns2:course.label: Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: Lectures, seminars, and practical work in German language, literature, civilization, and in other academic areas appropriate to the student's course of study. Maximum of 34 hours per academic year. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: GER 104 or equivalent; 2.75 overall average; 3.0 average in German courses.
